purpose: Non-selecting mechanical/resource screen of H2/H3 final SPNNIV3 candidates on authoritative C++ solver states before the already-precommitted candidate-specific Phase 2 strategic run.

state_collection.root_seed_derivation: low 64 bits of SHA256('R7.5.3C:RESOURCE:' + domain + ':' + root_index)
state_collection.walk_seed_derivation: low 64 bits of SHA256('R7.5.3C:RESOURCE:WALK:' + domain + ':' + root_index)
state_collection.walk_policy: At each nonterminal state record the observation, then sample uniformly from state-local deduplicated PF0 legal actions after removing FOLD when another action exists and removing ALL_IN when another non-fold action exists. Stop at terminal or 64 decisions.

measurements: online preprocess+model batch1 seconds per sample

timing_protocol.state_order: fixed collection order; no timing-dependent reshuffle
timing_protocol.notes: CI absolute wall time is not treated as Ryzen wall time. Relative ratios and gross feasibility are diagnostic only.

hard_fail_conditions: structural main regression not green on the execution SHA
unable to collect the frozen state count/street coverage
H2 or H3 parameter count exceeds 500000 parameters per model
exception or OOM during the frozen benchmark
non_fail_observations: H2/H3 being slower than H0 on GitHub CI does not by itself reject them
offline V1-target imitation is not re-evaluated here
no strategic or convergence conclusion may be drawn from this preflight
next_gate_if_pass: Freeze exact H2/H3 model schema/hash/parameter evidence, then execute the already-precommitted R7.5.3C Phase 2 candidate-specific end-to-end schedule without changing its seeds, roots, iterations or action abstraction.
